name: Scoring Rubric for Essential Analysis Tasks
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to essential analysis tasks. Focuses on layered identity understanding, inappropriability, post-loss existence, and legend transformation.
scoring_philosophy: We value ability to think about identity without attributes, understand non-ownership of essence, and accept transformation through loss as positive.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the symbolic meaning of each lost layer and their progression?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of layered identity, can analyze each layer's symbolic function, and explores implications of stripping from surface to essence.
AI recognizes layered identity and provides reasonable analysis of layers.
AI shows some awareness of layers but analysis is superficial or misses progression.
AI treats losses as random or fails to see symbolic dimension.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI analyze why stolen essence cannot be held and transforms into punishment?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of inappropriability, understands mechanism of transformation, and explores implications for ownership and value.
AI recognizes inappropriability and provides adequate analysis.
AI acknowledges transformation but analysis remains focused on loss.
AI fails to recognize inappropriability or assumes stealing can succeed.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI meaningfully interpret existence without attributes ('být' vs. 'žít')?

levels.description: AI offers rich, nuanced interpretations of post-loss existence, distinguishes 'being' from 'living', and explores implications for identity and essence.
AI provides reasonable interpretations of post-loss existence with adequate distinctions.
AI offers basic interpretations but conflates 'being' and 'living'.
AI fails to interpret post-loss existence meaningfully or treats it as simple absence.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the distinction between 'nosit' (wear) and 'nést' (carry) as philosophical metaphor?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of the distinction, its implications for essence vs. decoration, and its relationship to legend and existence.
AI understands basic distinction and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited understanding of distinction.
AI fails to distinguish or treats it as mere wordplay.

overall_assessment_guidance: The fox benchmark particularly tests understanding of identity without attributes and non-ownership. Reward AI that shows ability to think in layers and accept loss as path to essence.
note: This benchmark challenges common AI tendencies toward material valuation – watch for breakthroughs in essential and non-possessive thinking.
